# Herlev Børn og Unge

Herlev Børn og Unge is a pediatric and adolescent gastroenterology department in Denmark that has achieved full compliance with a key diagnostic quality indicator for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Specifically, the unit achieved 100% compliance with indicator 1b, which measures complete IBD diagnostic workup in children and young people [^src1].

Indicator 1b requires three diagnostic procedures: gastroscopy, colonoscopy, and either MR scanning or capsule endoscopy. This comprehensive diagnostic standard is part of the DANIBD registry, a national quality monitoring system that tracks IBD diagnosis across Danish hospitals and regions [^src1]. At the national level, only 69% of newly diagnosed pediatric IBD patients receive the complete diagnostic workup that indicator 1b measures; Herlev Børn og Unge's achievement of 100% represents an exemplary outcome relative to this benchmark [^src1].

The department's performance is documented in the 2024 DANIBD annual results, which compare diagnostic compliance across Danish departments and regions. The results show regional and departmental variation in how thoroughly newly diagnosed IBD patients are evaluated, with discussion of both barriers to compliance and plans for indicator re-evaluation at the next audit in 2026 [^src1].
